mainEntity.name: What is AI SEO and how is it different from regular SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular SEO tries to rank a page in Google's blue links. AI SEO tries to get your brand named and cited inside the answer itself, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode. The page work overlaps, but AI SEO puts far more weight on branded mentions across the web, answer-first formatting, structured data and pages that render without JavaScript.

mainEntity.name: Is AI SEO the same thing as GEO and AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Close enough. GEO (generative engine optimisation) and AEO (answer engine optimisation) are two names for the same goal: being the source an AI answer pulls from.

mainEntity.name: How much does AI SEO cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strategic Consulting is $1,000 one-time for the audit, 100 ranked queries and a 3-month strategy. Strategic Execution is $3,000 per month and includes technical SEO, 100 AI-feed pages and 25 branded placements. Deep Execution is $4,000 per month with 200 pages and 40 placements.

mainEntity.name: How long until AI SEO shows results?

acceptedAnswer.text: First content goes live in month one. On shilikajain.com, a brand-new domain ranked #1 for 'fractional PR manager crypto' within a month of launch. Meru Trophy compounded to 27,300 Google clicks over 16 months. AI citations usually trail Google rankings by a few weeks.

mainEntity.name: How do you measure AI visibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: Three lenses: a fixed prompt panel across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Mode; Google Search Console clicks, impressions and position; and AI referral traffic in analytics.
